stations.title: Sacrae disciplinae leges promulgates the Code now in force

stations.instrument: Responsum ad propositum dubium, coetus plenarius 30 Iunii 1992 (Pastor bonus art. 154)

interpretation.answer: Affirmative, and according to instructions to be given by the Apostolic See. A circular letter of the Congregation for Divine Worship of 15 March 1994 followed, whose first point says that c. 230 §2 has the force of permitting and not of commanding.
interpretation.basis: Read in the Holy See's Latin collection Interpretationes Authenticae, sha256 1e7a0aaa..., at the block headed by this canon; the Dicastery for Legislative Texts serves the same Latin on its own page for this canon and the two were compared and found identical.
interpretation.question: Whether service at the altar can be counted among the liturgical offices which lay people, men and women alike, may perform under c. 230 §2.
